about: Pain-point pool for Cotera Booth Bingo. Each set fills one 25-square board. 'short' shows on the grid, 'full' shows when a square is tapped. 'wedge' and 'persona' are hidden from players and only appear in the admin feed and CSV export.

items.full: Our lead routing runs on a spreadsheet and a prayer.
Our SDRs burn hours researching every account before they reach out.
Our ICP lives on a slide deck, not in a score anyone actually uses.
High-fit buyers sign up with a Gmail address and slip through the cracks.
Our enrichment data is stale by the time a rep opens the record.
We can't map who's actually on the buying committee.
We have plenty of leads and no idea which ones matter.
We can't tell which target accounts are actually in-market right now.
Our AI SDR sends volume, not relevance.

items.short: Event leads rot in a CSV
